posts.title: Traveller - Where Prep Is Play
posts.description: We say quite often in the solo gaming world that "prep is play." Meaning that preparing for your solo game - rolling characters, building a world or map to explore, getting all of the scaffolding of a campaign together - is a part of playing the game. posts.title: Almost a Year Later, Reviving the Blog
posts.description: I know I never kept up with this blog as much as I wanted to. Part of the reason was a lack of time and space to do my gaming living in an apartment with two roommates. I'm happy to announce that my wife and I are in the process of moving into our HOUSE that we OWN and there'll be a whole room in that house devoted to an art studio space/gaming area.
